name: 01-cover-drive.jpg
caption: Golden hour on Ocean Boulevard: chase-cam behind the clearcoat Solaris GT with its Bay Cyan neon underglow, ten-spoke alloys and twin chrome exhausts under a layered tropical sunset. A two-star SBPD cruiser closes on its rear quarter in cyan-and-gold unit livery with a steel push-bar and a four-lens lightbar. Traffic runs both ways, strollers fill both pavements, and the Art Deco hotels carry neon marquees. Mission 02 is on the objective card and the vector minimap shows the scalloped beach.

name: 02-police-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star sunset pursuit: livery-striped SBPD interceptors on the drifting supercar's bumper, a kerbside lamppost it clipped toppling dark, skid marks and tyre smoke, the helicopter's searchlight pinning it, a V roadblock ahead, lit glass bus shelters with backlit adverts, a bulb-marquee pavement cafe under striped umbrellas, and the neon Ferris wheel across the bay.

name: 03-on-foot-heist.jpg
caption: Mission 03 on foot: an over-the-shoulder SMG firefight at the Solaris Vault Bank Plaza (Art Deco colonnade, gold SOLARIS VAULT marquee, lit lobby glass). Armoured guards return fire. A bystander cowers with her hands over her head. The teal Coastal Muscle used as cover has recessed black wheel wells, ten-spoke rims over glowing brake calipers, a shaker hood scoop and a recessed LED tail bar.

name: 04-city-map.jpg
caption: The city menu (M): the organic coastal map of Solaris Bay with depth contours, Sunset Beach, Coral Pier, Starlight Key and colour-coded districts. The sidebars show the story arc, activities with gold and silver medals, personal bests and a live x1.75 streak multiplier, and the Safehouse Garage with its Lagoon Teal paint and Flamingo underglow.
